title: Broken bleed line cuts F-18 control lines on Saudi Arabia training run
place_text: Saudi Arabia training range / aircraft carrier

tellings.quote: things. One of those had broken and it was essentially like a plasma beam just cutting things inside the jet.

plain: On a training flight over a range in Saudi Arabia, a broken bleed line, a pipe that carries very hot air drawn off the engine, cut through control lines inside an F-18 Navy fighter jet. Ryan Graves, a Navy fighter pilot who was there, tells it as first-hand experience, saying it was "essentially like a plasma beam just cutting things inside the jet." He tells it to show how dangerous ordinary failures in these jets already are.
